integrity: The proof uses exact finite-pattern probabilities and a two-round back-and-forth criterion. The included Python checker tests finite cases and local signatures but does not certify the infinite asymptotic theorem.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite number of independent uniform orders; successor-only first-order language; quantifier rank at most two. No higher-rank first-order convergence law. Common-adjacency and Ehrenfeucht–Fraïssé ingredients are established techniques; historical priority of their exact combined limit-theory classification requires independent assessment.
title: Exact rank-two logical limit types for independent random successor orders
